'''Yuka Nishigaki''' (Japanese: '''西墻由香''' ''Nishigaki Yuka'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Nishigaki was born on September 3, 1982, in {{wp|Tottori Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She was affiliated with Ken Production and landed a number of roles in anime series since the 2000s. Nishigaki became involved with the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|DP}}, but voiced her best-known role in that work, [[Nihei]], one of the older brothers of {{Ash}}'s friend [[Sanpei]], during {{aniseries|XY}}. She is married to fellow voice actor {{wp|Tsubasa Yonaga}}.
